about: The cast of S3 (the Rainbow Bridge): one entry per painted figure (layout.json slug), from the needs list (gen/expand/rainbow_bridge_needs.md, "Casting") with the casting agent's calls; read by gen/sections/rainbow_bridge/make_people.py, which writes sections/rainbow_bridge/people.json. Fields: character (the dress's character: an existing one, or a new one the catalogue orders (gen/expand/round2/catalogue.md 1b: boatman, straw_hat, dark_hat, tracker, youth, groom, grain_porter), played by stand_in until characters.json lists it; wanted_why says why); act (the painted action, named as the clip the needs list gives; make_people.py's ALIAS chain maps it to the nearest clip the playing character has); take (the new Text to Motion take it waits for); second (a calmer second step of the cycle); props (carried props as painted); scale (children: the painted fraction of the adults beside them); walk (painted walking or carrying: a short walk along the painted direction and back; walk_dir says which way where the facing does not); held (painted walking but held to an animal that stands: stays with it, with the reason); haul (a tracker who walks with his boat); ride (the animal a rider sits on); seat (a mapped seat's map ID; stool: a seat the map lacks, for seats.json; floor: a floor sit on the support itself); rail (near: leans over the bridge's near railing); rail_along (at the railing, facing along it); at_animal / sedan / vehicle + at_end (who the figure works at); facing [deg, why] where the map gives none or the build needs another; note (the needs list's line, abridged). walk_take: the take a walker waits for; wants: clips wanted later but not played now (with wants_why); recast [model, why]: who plays a figure painted seated, crouching or riding while its character lacks that posture; prefer: clips tried before the act's chain for this figure. Updated to the catalogue (gen/expand/round2/catalogue.md, 2026-10-12).
